Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper around a distributed replicated log specification. It constrains the underlying system to a finite state space by assuming there is more than one server, assuming the set of Values is finite, and defining an operator that drops the longest common prefix shared by all current logs. The main design decision documented in comments is that bounding divergence and discarding the common prefix reduces the explored state space while preserving the interesting replicated-log behavior being analyzed.
